inspiration: One creature in several elements: the wyvern appears as fire, water and air variants under mods/fantasycore, and art_src keeps per-element diffuse maps (fire, water, air, earth) next to the base model. Recreate with our own base body and four colour passes (ember, tide, storm, stone), not separate sheets.

Eight-direction sprites from a turntable: render8dirs.py rotates a platform 45 degrees per step and renders each pass. For our characters, one turntable and one fixed camera give eight consistent facings.

A fixed action set per creature: stance, run, swing, cast, dash attack, hit and die for the wyvern. Copy the checklist, not the moves: every enemy gets the same states so combat code can treat them alike.
Behaviour sheets for a flying enemy: the montage notes name hover, fly, sting, breathe, ram and hit as separate sheets. Good for planning an aerial boss in our own moves.
Elemental statue guardians: three statue variants (wind, fire, ice) are defined as animations under a shared template in the minicore_alpha mod. A cheap family of three from one body.
Biome sets with a template per area: grassland, dungeon, cave, snowplains, ruins, iron labyrinth, each with a tile sheet and a Tiled template. Copy the template-per-biome habit for our zones.

A state-to-track table for music: title, town, overworld, forest, cave, dungeon, magical, unrest, battle, boss and safe room, plus a wind ambient bed. Use the idea (one track per game state) with our own music.
Mood and content note: the README says the game has violence, blood and mild gore. A dark palette with bruise tints and a limited red fits that tone without copying any art.
